_notes.generated_by: hand-written sample for the reference-style film
_notes.layouts: layout is host_full (presenter only), host_pip (b-roll + presenter PiP) or broll_only. Hybrid cut: host_full opens and closes the film, the body is b-roll.
_notes.transitions: transition is 'cut' (default, and what the reference film uses) or 'crossfade'.
_notes.grades: grade is 'cold' (night interiors, cool blue), 'warm' (daylight, muted amber) or 'neutral'.
_notes.captions: captions is an optional list of {text, from, to} chunks timed relative to the scene. Without it the caption line is split automatically to fit the shot.
_notes.swap_images: Put stills in remotion/public/episodes/<topic-slug>/ as scene-1.jpg, scene-2.jpg, ... and they are picked up automatically. Otherwise Pollinations.ai generates a still per scene from its prompt, or run with --images openai to use OpenAI's image API.

scenes.text: Rome did not fall in a day.
At its height, Rome reached farther than any empire before it.
Then the borders thinned, and the cost of holding them rose.
The end arrived in a hundred small surrenders.
What survives is stone, dust, and a warning.
